data.one_liner: An enhanced Flutter Stepper widget with alternate labels and customizable step icons.
data.what_it_does: Provides an alternative Stepper widget for Flutter that supports custom step icons, alternate labels, and flexible horizontal/vertical layouts.
use_when: You need a step-by-step wizard UI with customized step icons.
You require alternate title and line positions in a horizontal stepper.
avoid_when: You are starting a new project, as this package is officially deprecated.
You want a maintained package; the author recommends migrating to enhance_widget.
strengths: Adds customizable step icons and alternate labels to standard stepper behavior.
Supports both horizontal and vertical layouts easily.
weaknesses: The package is deprecated and no longer actively maintained.
Requires migration to enhance_widget for future updates.
data.minimal_example:
EnhanceStepper(
    stepIconSize: 30,
    type: _type,
    horizontalTitlePosition: HorizontalTitlePosition.bottom,
    horizontalLinePosition: HorizontalLinePosition.top,
    currentStep: _index,
    steps: [
      EnhanceStep(
        icon: Icon(Icons.directions_bike, color: Colors.blue, size: 30),
        title: Text('Step 0'),
        content: Text('Content'),
      ),
    ],
)
